## Load libraries and data

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)

raw_dir <- "data/_raw/"
data_file <- "gravier.RData"
data_loc <- "https://github.com/ramhiser/datamicroarray/raw/master/data/"

if( !dir.exists(raw_dir) ){
  dir.create(path = raw_dir)
}
if( !file.exists(str_c(raw_dir, data_file)) ){
  download.file(
    url = str_c(data_loc, data_file),
    destfile = str_c(raw_dir, data_file))
}
load(file = str_c(raw_dir, data_file))
```

### Data wrangling from week 2

```{r}
set.seed(676571)
cancer_data=mutate(as_tibble(pluck(gravier,"x")),y=pluck(gravier,"y"),pt_id=1:length(pluck(gravier, "y")),age=round(rnorm(length(pluck(gravier,"y")),mean=55,sd=10),1))
cancer_data=rename(cancer_data,event_label=y)
cancer_data$age_group=cut(cancer_data$age,breaks=seq(10,100,by=10))
cancer_data=relocate(cancer_data,c(pt_id,age,age_group,pt_id,event_label))
```

### Data analysis

#### Gene expression level

```{r}
ggplot(data = cancer_data,
       mapping = aes(x = g7F07)) +
  geom_histogram(bins=20) +
  labs(x = "Gene expression",
       y = "Count",
       title = "Histogram of g7F07 expression")
```

```{r}
#| label: histogram-of-arthur-favorite-gene

ggplot(data = cancer_data,
       mapping = aes(x = g1A01)) +
  geom_histogram(bins=20) +
  labs(x = "Gene expression",
       y = "Count",
       title = "Histogram of g1A01 expression")
```

This gene's expression level seems to follow a gaussian distribution centered in 0
